title: Very funny.
text: Exceptional. At first it seems not, but the plot is very good. Puzzles are simple and logical, very fun. The setting is very well done, with many interesting details. 10 out of 10.
author: Mireille D

title: Highly recommended
text: We have gone a group of 5 (3 had previously done some escape room and 2 had not). We couldn't finish it because fear plays an important factor in thinking. It is very busy and for us it was an experience to repeat. The Game Master was super friendly throughout. We will certainly repeat some others from this room. Highly recommended.

title: Xcape room Bcn: Miko's diary.
text: First time to make an xcape room. Tension, fear, laughter, we had a great time. Which for my taste the tests were somewhat difficult.
author: Crst90

title: Wonderful staff, unique experience
text:
We wanted to throw a surprise party for some friends, and if possible, have the option to participate in it. Our intention was to scare the birthday boys ourselves, while they tried to make a tension room. 
From the very first moment all the workers at Xcape room attended us with great kindness, and helped us in everything, without putting glues or problems. Oh, great. We are very happy with the result. We had a great time, the game masters super attentive and it turned out to be an amazing experience. 
We highly recommend doing any room with them!
author: Lua789654

title: Very well worked
